title: The Male CEO and the Female Assistant: Evaluation and Mitigation of Gender Biases in Text-To-Image Generation of Dual Subjects
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and mitigating gender biases in Text-To-Image generation, which is a central issue in AI ethics and fairness. It proposes a new evaluation framework (PST) and a mitigation method (FairCritic) specifically to address these biases. The paper also includes an 'Ethics Statement' discussing the propagation of stereotypes and biases from training data, framing its work as a novel evaluation setting to probe implicit biases.
